name: My Vote For 2027
tagline: Scores the declared hopefuls for France's 2027 presidency on five weighted criteria.
description: One voter's scorecard for the 2027 French presidential race, written in French. Every declared candidate gets rated against five criteria weighted from the author's own wiki, and a daily sweep of X keeps the evidence moving. A fixed morning run refreshes the standings, so the ranking follows the race as it is now.
author: LeTerryBZH
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
